testcase.name: upstream stale and implausibly future observations cannot be fresh
position reports a known gain and a known loss
chart preserves gaps and never fabricates samples
ambiguous and malformed amounts are rejected instead of silently changed
saved fresh quote becomes delayed at 30 minutes
invalid quotes and overflow do not produce an estimate
one hour window is relative to now not the last stale sample
missing price or cost never implies zero gains
number input accepts explicit decimal and grouped thousands
